g.text: Inside the circle is stable, outside is not, and the marker shapes carry the same

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: identity as the colours. The 600 Hz design sits just outside at 1.0018, which grows so

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: slowly that a short simulation looks settled: a twelve-millisecond run of it converges,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: and a sixty-millisecond run does not.
